# Soumil Garg

> Soumil Garg makes Meta (Facebook and Instagram) ads for D2C brands that people stop scrolling for, then runs them until they sell. He works with founders in the US and India.

## Offer
- Three free changes for the ads a brand is running now, sent within 24 hours. No call, no ad account access. Reply to his email or send your website.
